mentions.name: Plastic Bins by Dimension Search
mentions.description: This tool lets shoppers find and buy plastic bins by their dimension sizes rather than by listed volume, searching across multiple stores.
mentions.problem: Plastic bins are typically sold by volume, making it hard to find bins that fit specific dimensions.
mentions.source_excerpt: A way to buy plastic bins by dimension size instead of volume. That supports multiple stores.

evidence.value: A way to buy plastic bins by dimension size instead of volume. That supports multiple stores.
